Dev note: To help bridge the information gap between players using voice chat and those who aren't, we've added the Resolve Bar to the HUD. This will help Survivors determine if the Killer is camping and plan their next move accordingly.

Dev note: To make the Anti-Facecamp mechanic fairer to both sides, we've reduced the base fill rate and added the time the Killer remains near the hook as a modifier. This gives Killers who are not camping more freedom to pass by a hook (particularly in cramped spaces like hallways) without worrying about the meter filling and giving the Survivor a free escape. This also means that Survivors who are being camped for extended periods gain the ability to unhook themselves slightly earlier.

Dev note: Following the release of the updated AFK crow system, we increased the time it took to gain crows. This was much too generous, allowing for Survivors to avoid crows too easily. We're dialing back the values a little bit to a middle ground between the original values and the live values.

repeated_change_wording.change_text: Crews exploring this volcanic region will find that the frequency of discovering the ferocious Chest of Rage in their treasure hoard has increased across a range of activities.

The frequency of shipwreck discoveries has been increased and there is now an equal chance of finding a regular shipwreck or a Smugglers’ Shipwreck, both containing handy air bubbles throughout the ship to help pirates while exploring.
The glint of a washed-up Message in a Bottle on the shores now provides a range of different activities and will no longer just provide a Smugglers’ Run.

As the fires of Act 1 begin, a range of new Commendations have been added to the Secrets of the Banished Reputation tab. Pirates completing these Commendations will unlock access to new weapons from the Forsaken Ashes set, Mark of the Widow Tattoo, Chest of Banished Tribute Disguise and ‘Effigy of Rage’ Trinket – and from the Smugglers’ clothing set, Saltbones Elias’ Hook and Laughing Fox Lucia’s Mask.
New time-limited Act 1 Deeds have been added to the Season menu, earning players a boost to their Seasonal Renown progression and the ‘A Dark Discovery’ Painting once completed.

Crews engaging with rivals in naval combat will find that ambush threats like Skeleton Ships and Megalodons are now reduced in frequency. While these unpredictable encounters can still occur, they will now be much less frequent, allowing crews to remain focused on their rivals.
Exiting crouch by sprinting and quickly aiming down sights should no longer cause pirates to briefly stutter.
Crews experiencing technical issues when diving beneath the waves should no longer find themselves returned to the surface alongside a duplicate version of their ship.
Sailing near a Skeleton Camp no longer causes ship interiors to appear overly bright.
A blowpipe musical tune should no longer be heard when on the Ferry of the Damned.
Sprinting while holding a Fort Key no longer causes hand animations to jump after stopping.
Players firing the Alter Ego Eye of Reach should no longer find the weapon clips into the camera.
Players should no longer be able to grapple into the roof decoration of the tavern at Morrow’s Peak Outpost.
During a storm, rain can no longer be seen within the Pirate Emporium.
Players using Italian language settings should no longer see overlapping text when equipping various weapons within the Armoury.
Players using Thai language settings will find the Alter Ego set name has been changed to better match its visual appearance.
Players can no longer use various methods to duplicate their stock of hunting spears.

repeated_change_wording.change_text: Fixed a bug where you could take damage during the roll.

Our goal with this change to Corrupted Blood is to make it so that they no longer trigger counters. That takes away a significant portion of its PvP advantage, while touching something that is rarely used for such a small amount of value in PvE. Additionally, the dash speed reduction makes them a lot more manageable to dodge in PvE, and that additional touch of making them unable to cause a fatal blow means they’ll never be responsible for an outright death.
The hostile ghost spawned by Corrupted Blood has its dash speed reduced and will now pierce enemies. The damage will no longer trigger counters. Damage from ghosts can no longer cause a fatal blow.
Cooldown gained from canceling the spell has been increased from 50% to 65%.
Reduced the penalty per target from 6-10% to 8-16% (Jewel Effect)
Added a 0.5-second delay before explosion on recast. (Jewel Effect)
Dash duration reduced from 0.45 seconds to 0.4 seconds.
Damage bonus for trying to apply freeze on an immune target has been increased from 25% to 30%.
No longer leeches health to the player through Spell Leech attribute.
Dash duration changed from 0.3 seconds to 0.4 seconds.
Increased cast time from 0.15 seconds to 0.4 seconds.
Reduced damage per tick by 15% and moved that damage to the final tick.

To make more ultimates a bit more attractive, we decided to lower the duration of Raging Tempest while keeping the damage the same. That means the overall damage per second is increased, and lets you hop back into the fight to keep up the pressure.
Reduced duration from 3 seconds to 2.5 seconds while keeping total damage dealt.
Increased shield from 500% to 550% of your spell power.
Increased initial heal from 50% to 55% of your spell power.
Bonus damage reduced from 20-40% to 14-30% (Jewel Effect)

* Massively improved retrieval speed of the friends server list.
* Fixed memory leak that occurred when generating subsequent new worlds
* Changed certain sound files to be loaded in background, reducing some specific lag spikes
* Added a fix for movement to behave the same when holding down secondary attack while moving with the gamepad as on keyboard.
* Fixed a bug that caused inaccurate collision detection between AoEs and characters in multiplayer scenarios, e.g. sometimes catching on fire even when not walking into the fire.
* Fixed mouse being stuck held down after naming a map pin with virtual keyboard.
* Improved chat message and sign compliance with platform privileges, parental controls and local block list
* Reduced memory usage of profile pictures in Player List
* Fixed a bug where tooltips in settings menu did not show up in-game
* Fixed a freeze that could occur when changing the permitted list
* Fixed an issue that made some events able to trigger without their conditions being met
* Chat messages can no longer be sent if text communication is disabled via system. Also shows a system UI popup telling users to change the setting if they want to chat
* Fixed a bug that could make the “Game Preview” popup appear again after being dismissed
* Reduced reserved space on Xbox console, reducing disk usage by up to 1 GiB
* Gamepad navigation in menus is no longer jittery and too quick to use
* Fixed an issue causing renaming of signs and portal with gamepads to break
* There is no longer movement stuttering when using certain inputs
* There should no longer be a stutter when getting close to the bog witch hut
* Virtual keyboard no longer appears multiple times
* Multiple players can no longer eat the same piece of served food
* Crafting skill no longer provides bonus yield on armour and weapons

* World modifier “No Build Cost” no longer allows food to be placed freely, this is now part of the “No Craft Cost” world modifier
* Resin candles that have been blown out no longer start burning when logging into a server
* Resin candles no longer sink into the surface they are placed on
* Asksvin Cape has been reworked with increased run speed and reduced stamina use for running
* Added the ability to craft x5 at once when holding down shift or left stick
* Some old hardcoded strings have been fixed and are now properly localised
* Console command added: ‘sortcraft’ to be able to sort crafting lists by name, type, weight, count or original
* Reduced radius of burn area on fire pits
* Fixed visual bug with Asksvin Rug and Straw
* Fixed input loss that occured when running the game at lower framerates
* Fixed the slope-knockback bug that could occur when hitting enemies with some attacks while on a steep slope
* Fixed issue where if menu was opened during the generation of a new world, the join code would not be displayed
* Game no longer crashes when blocking/unblocking other player and exiting player list too fast
* Fixed a bug where you could infinitely get stuck on "logging in to backend service" if you had deleted your playfab account and subsequently lost internet
* Fixed Chat/NPC text not clamping correctly to screen borders on resolutions other than 1080p.
* Fixed bug with resolution confirmation popup not showing up if you switch to other settings tab and click OK
* Fixed so that the framerate slider movement speeds up if held down when using a gamepad
* Main audio device should no longer swap upon game launch
* Dragging the window around no longer triggers left mouse button clicks
* Forward and backward mouse buttons are no longer incorrectly recognized as middle mouse button
* Fixed Steam overlay not being openable via shortcut
